local p = {}
local data = {
	weapon6 = mw.loadData('Module:Weapon/weapon6'),
	weapon5 = mw.loadData('Module:Weapon/weapon5'),
	weapon4 = mw.loadData('Module:Weapon/weapon4'),
	weapon3 = mw.loadData('Module:Weapon/weapon3'),
}
local getArgs = require('Module:Arguments').getArgs
local yesno = require('Module:Yesno')
function p.main(frame)
	local args = getArgs(frame, {
		wrappers = 'Template:Weapon'
	})
	return p._main(args)
end
function p._main(args)
	local key = args[1]
	local weapon
	for k, v in pairs(data) do
		weapon = v[key]
		if weapon then
			break
		end
	end
	if not weapon then
		mw.log('Weapon data missing:', key)
		return '&#32;<i>Weapon not found</i>&#32;' -- no entry.
	end
	local name = weapon.name
	local title = weapon.title
	local pagename = weapon.link or name
	local text = args[2] or title or name
	local attrs = {
		['data-name'] = name,
		['data-title'] = title,
		['data-star'] = tonumber(weapon.star),
		['data-class'] = weapon.class,
	}
	local gridview = yesno(args.g or args.gv or args.gridview)
	local container = mw.html.create('')
	if gridview then
		local wrapper = container:tag('div')
		:css{display='inline-block', position='relative', margin='5px'}
		local a = wrapper:tag('div')
		:addClass('a')
		local dtooltip = a:tag('div')
		:addClass('weapon-tooltip')
		:attr(attrs)
		:wikitext('[[File:'..name..' icon.png|60x60px|link='..pagename..'|alt='..text..']]')
		local border = args.border
		if border == 'limited' then
			dtooltip:css('border', '1px solid #FF0000')
		elseif border == 'limited2' then
			dtooltip:css('border', '1px solid #FF8000')
		elseif border == 'store' then
			dtooltip:css('border', '1px solid #FFFF00')
		end
	else
		local stooltip = container:tag('span')
		:addClass('weapon-tooltip')
		:attr(attrs)
		:wikitext('[['..pagename..'|'..text..']]')
	end
	return container
end
return p
